title: Transfer substrate, electronic device and manufacturing method of transfer substrate
abstract: To provide a transfer substrate capable of improving a yield, an electronic device and a manufacturing method of the transfer substrate.SOLUTION: A transfer substrate comprises: a substrate including a first top face; a conductive film which is provided on the substrate and includes a second top face; and a first insulator film which is provided on the substrate and directly in contact with the conductive film and includes a third top face continued to the second top face. The second top face and the third top face are tilted from the first top face in a boundary between the second top face and the third top face.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title: Composite thin film structure, preparation method thereof and electronic component
abstract: The application provides a composite film structure, a preparation method thereof and an electronic component, wherein the composite film structure comprises a substrate layer, a first composite isolation layer formed on the top surface of the substrate layer and at least two film layers formed on the first composite isolation layer; a second isolating layer is arranged between two adjacent thin film layers; the first composite isolation layer comprises at least two stacked sub-isolation layers; the thin film layer is used for transmitting signals, and the first composite isolation layer and the second isolation layer are used for preventing signal leakage. A first composite isolation layer having at least two stacked sub-isolation layers is disposed between the substrate layer and the first thin film layer. Compare in prior art, only adopt the mode of individual layer isolation layer, first compound isolation layer can be with the signal isolation of first thin layer transmission, prevents that the signal from revealing the substrate layer.

title: Apparatus and method for measuring modified area of substrate
abstract: To provide a substrate reforming area measuring device.SOLUTION: The imaging apparatus includes a first imaging device 101, a second imaging device 102, a third imaging device 103, and a microcomputer unit 104. The first imaging device faces the first surface of the substrate 110 and is configured to photograph the substrate to obtain a first image. The second imaging device faces the second surface of the substrate and is configured to photograph the substrate to obtain a second image. The first surface of the substrate is opposite to the second surface of the substrate. The third imaging device obliquely faces the first surface of the substrate or the second surface of the substrate, and is configured to photograph the substrate to obtain a third image. The micro-processor unit obtains a modified area measurement information of at least one modified area of the substrate according to the first image, the second image and the third image.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title: Wiring board and method for manufacturing wiring board
abstract: The wiring substrate is provided with: a substrate having transparency; a plurality of first wirings disposed on an upper surface of the substrate and extending in a first direction, the first wirings having a back surface contacting the substrate and a surface facing an opposite side of the back surface; and a second wiring which is arranged on the upper surface of the substrate and extends in a second direction intersecting the first direction, and has a back surface in contact with the substrate and a surface facing the opposite side of the back surface. The first wiring has a pair of side surfaces extending in the first direction and adjacent to the back surface of the first wiring, and the pair of side surfaces of the first wiring are recessed toward the inside. The second wiring has a pair of side surfaces extending in the second direction and adjacent to the back surface of the second wiring, and the pair of side surfaces of the second wiring are recessed toward the inside.

title: Reflection board
abstract: To provide a reflection board which can reduce a manufacturing cost.SOLUTION: A reflection board 1 that reflects an electromagnetic wave of a specified frequency band to a direction different from a specular direction, includes an uneven structure in which a plurality of unit structures 10 including a thickness distribution where a thickness is increased to a predetermined direction is arranged. The unit structure 10 includes a plurality of cell regions 11a to 11f each having a different thickness, at least includes a first unit structure having two or more cell regions each having a different thickness as a unit structure, and includes a conductive layer 3 on a surface on each uneven structure side. Both of the adjacent cell regions are conducted.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title: Environment-friendly device applied to film blowing equipment of gold stamping film
abstract: The utility model discloses an environment-friendly device applied to film blowing equipment of a gold stamping film, which belongs to the technical field of gold stamping film blowing and comprises a supporting base, wherein the outer surfaces of one sides of two connecting plates which are towards each other are respectively connected with a storage roller and a guide roller in a rotating way, the outer surfaces of the storage roller and the guide roller are both wound with gold stamping film bodies, the top of the supporting base is provided with a limiting assembly, the limiting assembly is connected with a movable clamping assembly, a second driving motor is started in the process of winding the gold stamping film bodies and then can drive a two-way threaded rod to rotate, the two-way threaded rod drives two movable blocks to move oppositely/relatively in the rotating process, so that the clamping blocks on the two connecting blocks can be driven to clamp the gold stamping film bodies, rubber pads on the clamping blocks can prevent damage to the gold stamping film bodies, prevent the gold stamping film bodies from shifting in the winding process, and the matching of the rectangular grooves and the sliding blocks can limit the movable blocks, so that the quality of the gold stamping film in the winding process is improved.

title: Core board testing device with high automation degree
abstract: The utility model discloses a core board testing device with high automation degree, which comprises a bottom plate, wherein one end of the bottom plate is provided with an adjusting component, one end of the adjusting component is provided with an adsorption component, one side of the bottom plate is provided with a detection component and a placing box, and a rotating component and a clamping component are arranged in the placing box; the adjusting part is including setting up the hydraulic stem one in the square inslot that bottom plate one end was seted up, hydraulic stem one end is equipped with the connecting block, examine time measuring when needs are examined nuclear core plate, start conveyer belt one and conveyer belt two, adjusting part control adsorption component's position, adsorb nuclear core plate through adsorption component, place the core on the centre gripping subassembly, carry out the centre gripping through the centre gripping subassembly to nuclear core plate, detect and test nuclear core plate through detection component after then, nuclear core plate after the test is accomplished is adsorbed by the adsorption component of the bottom plate other end and is placed conveyer belt two, accomplish the transport, set up the test that can carry out the streamlined formula on this, the efficiency that detects is improved, and then the production efficiency of improvement enterprise.

title: Dust-free material placement mechanism for dust-free cotton swab production
abstract: The utility model relates to a dust-free material placement mechanism for dust-free cotton swab production, which comprises a first power piece, a mounting frame, a third power piece, a first placement component and a second placement component, wherein the mounting frame is movably connected with the first power piece through the second power piece, the first placement component is movably connected with the mounting frame through a connecting piece, the third power piece is connected with the mounting frame, the third power piece is meshed with the connecting piece, a driven wheel is arranged on the connecting piece and meshed with the third power piece, a second hole is formed in the second placement component, and air pipe connectors are respectively arranged on the first placement component and the second placement component and are respectively communicated with the first hole and the second hole. The utility model provides a dust-free material placement mechanism for dust-free cotton swab production, which reduces the labor intensity, improves the working efficiency and improves the automation degree of workshops.

title: Laser marking machine
abstract: The utility model discloses a laser marking machine which comprises an operation table, wherein an accommodating groove is formed in the upper end of the operation table, a conveyor belt is connected in the accommodating groove in a rotating mode through a rotating shaft, a lifting column is fixedly arranged at the upper end of the operation table, a scale staff is arranged at the front end of the lifting column, an adjusting knob is arranged at the upper end of the lifting column, a sliding seat is connected to the side face of the lifting column in a sliding mode, a marking assembly is arranged on the sliding seat, a clamping assembly is arranged at the upper end of the operation table, and two groups of clamping assemblies are symmetrically arranged on two sides of the conveyor belt respectively. According to the laser marking device, the motor is arranged on the sliding seat to drive the gear to rotate, so that the toothed plate fixedly connected with the laser marking head is driven to move back and forth, the moving range of the laser marking head is larger, and the laser marking efficiency is higher; and set up the clamping assembly on the operation panel, be equipped with infrared controller and detect accurate to beat the mark product and carry out the centre gripping fixedly to beating the mark product, guarantee to beat the mark product and be difficult to the skew when beating the mark, beat the mark more accurate.

title: Transfer assembly for sizing roller machining
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of sizing roller processing, in particular to a transfer assembly for sizing roller processing, which comprises a transfer frame, wherein a row of vertically-installed rotating shafts are arranged on the right side of the inner space of the transfer frame, fixing plates are circumferentially distributed on the outer sides of the rotating shafts, a limiting plate capable of being vertically inserted and pulled is arranged on the left side of the inner space of the transfer frame, a through hole is formed in the side wall of the transfer frame, which is close to the rotating shafts, a fixing seat is arranged along the upper edge of the through hole, a rotatable limiting rod is arranged in the fixing seat, and the limiting rod rotates towards the through hole and is pressed against the corresponding fixing plate, is more practical.

title: Bias circuit and radio frequency power amplifier
abstract: The utility model discloses a bias circuit and a radio frequency power amplifier, which belong to the technical field of high-power lasers, wherein the bias circuit comprises a programmable digital-to-analog conversion module, an enabling signal end of the module is respectively connected with one end of a filter capacitor C 1 、C 2 and one end of a voltage stabilizing inductor L 1 , the other end of the filter capacitor C 1 、C 2 is grounded, an external enabling signal is connected with the external enabling signal through the other end of the voltage stabilizing inductor L 1 , and the external enabling signal is input to the programmable digital-to-analog conversion module after voltage stabilization and capacitance filtering, so that the output voltage of the module can be stabilized, the precision requirement of digital-to-analog conversion is ensured, the precision control of the required bias voltage is realized, and the stability and the precision of the bias voltage are further ensured. Meanwhile, when the power amplification chip changes, parameters of the programmable digital-to-analog conversion module can be flexibly adjusted. Based on the method, the complexity of the bias circuit can be reduced and the flexibility of the bias circuit can be improved on the premise of ensuring stability and accuracy.

title: High-speed signal transmission circuit and control method based on same
abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides a high-speed signal transmission circuit and a control method based on the high-speed signal transmission circuit, and relates to the field of printed circuits, wherein the high-speed signal transmission circuit comprises a sensing value compensation module, a capacitive adjustment module and a layer-changing through hole module; when the high-speed signal output by the layer-changing through hole module is received, the capacitive adjustment module is used for carrying out negative bias treatment on the working frequency of the high-speed signal, so that the high-speed signal is respectively subjected to frequency raising and frequency lowering through the inductance value compensation module and the capacitive adjustment module, and the electromagnetic interference shielding effect of frequency division of the high-speed signal is achieved through secondary fine adjustment of the working frequency of the high-speed signal; the extra design cost of the whole machine for the EMI is reduced, and the reliability of the product is improved.

title: Digital isolator for improving common mode transient immunity
abstract: The application discloses a digital isolator for improving common mode transient immunity, which relates to the technical field of integrated circuit isolation and comprises a pair of transceiver chips, wherein each transceiver chip has the same structure and comprises a transmitting module and a receiving module; and the digital control module is used for controlling one of the pair of transceiver chips to be in a transmitting mode and the other to be in a receiving mode. Connecting two identical transceiver modules together can realize multi-channel signal transmission in any direction. In addition, an envelope detection module, a CMTIenhancing module and a noise elimination module are also disclosed, which are used for improving the common mode transient immunity of the digital isolator and solving the problem that the attenuation of the transmission signal is greatly affected by noise.

title: Low-power-consumption reference voltage circuit system based on dynamic compensation
abstract: The invention relates to the field of reference voltage design, in particular to a low-power-consumption reference voltage circuit system based on dynamic compensation, which comprises: the reference voltage compensation circuit and the load circuit are selectively connected to the same reference voltage end of the reference voltage circuit, and when the load circuit obtains a forward current from the reference voltage end, the reference voltage compensation circuit provides a compensation current for the reference voltage end so as to compensate the voltage drop of the reference voltage end. The invention has the advantages that: 1) The reference voltage buffer circuit design based on dynamic compensation utilizes the charge sharing principle, can greatly reduce the power consumption and the area of an analog-digital conversion system, and indirectly improves the conversion speed of an analog-digital converter; 2) Logic signal generation circuits with corresponding dynamically adjusted charge compensation are used to achieve fast detection and response.

title: Tuning switch circuit and radio frequency chip
abstract: The invention provides a tuning switch circuit and a radio frequency chip, wherein the tuning switch circuit comprises a switch bias unit, a tuning switch unit and a tuning device unit which are connected in sequence; the switch bias unit comprises a negative pressure generating module, a first positive pressure generating module, a second positive pressure generating module, a voltage driving module and a logic control module; the tuning switch unit comprises a multi-stage stacked field effect transistor circuit formed by sequentially connecting the multi-stage stacked field effect transistor circuit in series, wherein each stage of stacked field effect transistor circuit comprises a field effect transistor and a first resistor. The tuning switch circuit can reduce the on-resistance of the tuning switch circuit without increasing the area of the field effect transistor.

title: Polymer member-inorganic based matrix complex, manufacturing method thereof and polymer member therefor
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a useful method to bond a polymer member to an inorganic matrix without using glue, and the polymer member for this purpose. SOLUTION: A polymer member-inorganic based matrix complex, a manufacturing method thereof and a polymer member therefor are provided. A method to manufacture the polymer member-inorganic based matrix complexes 210, 220 includes: providing a thermal modified polymer layer-inorganic based matrix complexes 110, 120 in which one or multiple thermal modified polymer layers 20, 21, 22 adhere on an inorganic based matrix 10; and joining polymer member 30, 31, 32 to the inorganic based matrix with one or multiple thermal modified polymer layers 20, 21, 22. title: Durable PID (potential induced degradation) resistant packaging adhesive film and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a durable PID (potential induced degradation) resistant packaging adhesive film and a preparation method thereof, and relates to the technical field of hot melt adhesives. When the durable PID-resistant packaging adhesive film is prepared, p-vinylphenyl dichlorophosphate is prepared by reacting p-hydroxystyrene with phosphorus oxychloride, and modified nano-alumina is prepared by reacting nano-alumina with p-vinylphenyl dichlorophosphate and bisphenol A after reacting with p-hydroxyphenyltriethoxysilane; reacting ammonia methanol solution with methyl acrylate to prepare a prepolymer, and reacting the prepolymer, p-amino styrene and ethylenediamine to prepare modified hyperbranched polyamide; mixing, melting and extruding the ethylene-vinyl acetate copolymer, the modified nano aluminum oxide, the modified hyperbranched polyamide, the mixed additive and the crosslinking assistant, and preparing the durable PID-resistant packaging adhesive film through casting molding, surface embossing, cooling, traction, slitting and rolling. The durable PID-resistant packaging adhesive film prepared by the invention has excellent flame retardant property, mildew resistance and stripping resistance.

title: Tung oil-based polyurethane film with bright structural color and preparation method thereof
abstract: The application relates to the field of high polymer materials, and particularly discloses a tung oil-based polyurethane film with a bright structural color and a preparation method thereof. The polyurethane film takes monodisperse spherical silica, olefin-based blocked tung oil-based aqueous polyurethane emulsion, carbon black and ultraviolet initiator as main raw materials, and a network structure formed by long aliphatic side chain crosslinking of the olefin-based blocked tung oil-based aqueous polyurethane emulsion is more beneficial to self-assembly of the monodisperse spherical silica, and meanwhile, the long aliphatic side chain crosslinking also endows the structural color polyurethane film with excellent hydrophobicity and tensile strength.

title: Preparation process of extinction PE film for cotton soft towel packaging
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of extinction films and discloses a preparation process of an extinction PE film for packaging cotton soft towels, which comprises the steps of taking dibutyl phosphite, 2- (oxazolidine-3-yl) ethanol and di (hydrogenated tallow) phthalic acid amide as raw materials, synthesizing a tetra-long chain alkylated dibutyl phosphate monomer, modifying the tetra-long chain alkylated dibutyl phosphate monomer on the surface of SiO 2 through a covalent grafting method to obtain a solvent-free nano SiO 2 fluid with a core-shell structure, filling the solvent-free nano SiO 2 fluid into a polyethylene and polypropylene mixed resin matrix, mixing to form a homogeneous system, obtaining extinction master batches, taking the extinction master batches as outer layer raw materials, high-density polyethylene resin as intermediate layer raw materials and metallocene polyethylene resin as inner layer raw materials, and adopting a three-layer coextrusion blow molding film forming process to prepare the extinction PE film for packaging cotton soft towels. The extinction PE film developed by the invention has very excellent extinction performance while the tear resistance is only slightly reduced.

title: Polyethylene stearic acid coated papermaking process and paper
abstract: The application relates to the technical field of pulping and papermaking, and provides a polyethylene stearic acid coated papermaking process and paper, wherein the polyethylene stearic acid coated paper comprises a substrate layer, a paper pulp layer and a paper pulp layer, wherein the substrate layer comprises paper pulp fibers; the functional layer covers at least part of the surface of the transition layer, and comprises polyethylene stearic acid and nano particles. The polyethylene stearic acid coated paper adopts a three-layer composite structure combining a substrate layer, a transition layer and a functional layer, and aims to solve the problems of weak adhesive force, discontinuous film formation, poor folding endurance, unstable barrier property and the like caused by large surface energy difference between the polyethylene stearic acid with strong hydrophobicity and hydrophilic paper pulp fibers.

title: Method for monitoring platform to send WeChat message
abstract: The invention discloses a method for sending a WeChat message by a monitoring platform, which relates to the technical fields of computer science and software engineering and comprises the steps of constructing a multi-account credential pool, distributing a request through a weight polling algorithm, monitoring the call quantity of each account interface in real time, switching to a standby account and triggering a token cooling mechanism when the call frequency of a single account reaches a preset threshold, automatically generating WeChat interface permission configuration by adopting a declaration template based on an intelligent configuration engine, verifying legality through a configuration self-checking module, automatically triggering a domain name service provider API to finish recording update if the condition that a domain name is not recorded and a certificate is expired is detected, executing a key information extraction algorithm on an ultra-long text, identifying a monitoring index based on a BERT model, compressing the monitoring index to be within a WeChat limit length, generating a skip link, calling a GPU (graphic processing unit) to accelerate compression pipeline for picture data, and dynamically scaling the resolution to a preset size. The proposal solves the problems of frequency limitation, fussy authority configuration and message format constraint of the WeChat interface.

title: Parsing event data for clustering and classification
abstract: In some implementations, a classification system may receive credentials associated with a data source and may receive, from the data source and using the credentials, a set of structured data including input events and output events. The classification system may filter the set of structured data by applying a first set of rules to generate a filtered set of structured data and may convert the filtered set of structured data to one or more numerical vectors, where a vector space associated with the one or more numerical vectors is infinite-dimensional. The classification system may further cluster the one or more numerical vectors using a first machine learning model to generate one or more clusters. Accordingly, the classification system may determine one or more classifications based on the set of structured data, each of the one or more classifications being associated with a corresponding frequency and a corresponding category.

title: E-commerce operation management system based on cloud platform
abstract: The invention discloses an electronic commerce operation management system based on a cloud platform, and relates to the technical field of cloud computing. The E-commerce server acquires daily original interaction data of a target E-commerce user, encrypts the original interaction data to obtain first data, and uploads the first data to the cloud server; the cloud server divides the first data into a preset number of data blocks, randomly stores the data blocks into storage spaces of the distributed storage modules, and generates a storage dictionary corresponding to the first data; and when the cloud server receives a data analysis request of the e-commerce server, restoring and decrypting the first data according to the storage dictionary to obtain original interaction data, performing data analysis on the original interaction data to determine the current operation management risk, and sending an early warning message to the e-commerce server according to the operation management risk. The system stores the data in the cloud by adopting encryption and segmentation modes, and the cloud server can restore and analyze the data only by receiving an authorization file of the e-commerce server, so that the security of data privacy is ensured.

title: AI-based system and method for establishing channelized communications
abstract: AI-based system for establishing channelized communications and resource management for an organization. The system includes: a processor of a channel server node connected to an organization network; a memory on which are stored machine-readable instructions that when executed by the processor, cause the processor to: monitor the at least one organization network to collect analytics data comprising workflow data, generate a plurality of classifiers based on the analytics data, the plurality of classifiers comprising data reflecting nodes and associated pivot objects of the at least one organization network, feed the plurality of classifiers to an AI/ML module configured to output configuration parameters for at least one communication channel; and generate the at least one communication channel for the at least one organization network based on the configuration parameters.

title: Information processing method and device and computing equipment
abstract: The embodiment of the application provides an information processing method, an information processing device and computing equipment, wherein the method comprises the following steps: detecting a system access request initiated by a target user aiming at a target processing system; determining decision results respectively generated by a plurality of online decision models at the target processing system in response to the system access request; determining target recommendation information based on decision results respectively corresponding to the plurality of online decision models; and outputting the target recommendation information for the target user. The embodiment of the application improves the recommendation accuracy and effectiveness.

title: Dynamic covalent composite DA@GLM/MFC aerogel material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract: The invention relates to a dynamic covalent composite DA@GLM/MFC aerogel material, a preparation method and application thereof, belonging to the field of photothermal conversion materials, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps: preparing a partially oxidized MFC cryogel, (2) preparing dopamine hydrochloride modified gallium-based liquid metal DA-GLM nano droplets, (3) dispersing the DA-GLM nano droplets in an ethanol solution, and then soaking the MFC cryogel in the solution to obtain a dynamic covalent composite DA@GLM/MFC aerogel material; the dynamic covalent composite DA@GLM/MFC aerogel material obtained by the invention constructs a dynamic covalent bonding structure by using Schiff base bonds, so that a liquid metal and aerosol composite material with stable bonding is obtained, and the obtained material has excellent photo-thermal performance, high strength and toughness mechanical performance and ultra-stable cycle performance, and can strengthen the adsorption and catalytic degradation capability of salt ions and improve the photo-thermal conversion efficiency through being used as a solar drive interface evaporation material.

title: Bismuth oxide core-shell nanoparticle modified porous defect-rich carbon nitride material, preparation method and application thereof
abstract: The invention relates to a bismuth oxide core-shell nanoparticle modified porous defect-rich carbon nitride material, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the method comprises the following steps of calcining urea in an air atmosphere to obtain In (1) Under atmosphere to Calcining to obtain porous carbon nitride rich in defects At room temperature, glycol liquid, nitric acid solution, polyvinylpyrrolidone, Solid body Mixing to obtain a mixed solution, placing the mixed solution in a reaction kettle, heating in water bath to obtain precipitate ‌, filtering out the precipitate, and cleaning, drying and grinding the precipitate to obtain powder And (3) obtaining the bismuth oxide core-shell nano particle modified porous defect-rich carbon nitride material through the solid. Pairs of materials prepared according to the present disclosure And Has strong response capability.

title: Pomegranate-like high-entropy alloy/carbon nano hybrid material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a pomegranate-like high-entropy alloy/carbon nano hybrid material and a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of new material preparation and catalysis. According to the invention, potassium chloroaluminate, potassium tetrachloropalladate, potassium hexachloroplatinate, potassium hexachlororhodium and potassium hexachloroiridium are used as precursor salts of high-entropy alloy, carbon nano hybrid materials embedded with ultrafine AuPdPtRhIr high-entropy alloy nano particles are synthesized through a limited-domain carbonization strategy of polyvinyl alcohol, and the pomegranate-like nano hybrid structure can effectively inhibit intrinsic aggregation of the high-entropy alloy nano particles in the electrochemical reaction process, so that a large specific surface area and highly exposed active sites of an electrode are maintained. The preparation process of the pomegranate-like high-entropy alloy/carbon nano hybrid material is simple, and the material has excellent catalytic activity and Faraday efficiency in the field of electrocatalytic nitrogen oxidation, and has good commercialization prospect.

title: Ion imprinting covalent organic framework material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract: The invention discloses an ion imprinting covalent organic framework material, a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of organic high polymer porous materials. The method comprises the steps of carrying out ultrasonic mixing on a functional monomer with C 2v symmetry, planar hexacoordinated metal imprinting ions and a solvent to obtain a C 3 symmetry hexasite coordination complex, adding a solvent-dispersed C 3 symmetry node monomer into a system of the C 3 symmetry hexasite coordination complex to carry out ultrasonic mixing again, adding a catalyst solution to carry out ultrasonic post reaction to obtain a reaction product, carrying out post-treatment on the reaction product to obtain a metal covalent organic framework ion imprinting COFs precursor, dispersing the metal covalent organic framework ion imprinting COFs precursor into a sulfuric acid solution to carry out elution, and then carrying out post-treatment to obtain the ion imprinting covalent organic framework material. The method solves the problems that the crystallinity is difficult to control, the scale synthesis is difficult, and the specific coordination environment cannot be constructed.

title: Preparation method of porous nanocomposite and application of porous nanocomposite in ammonia borane hydrolysis hydrogen production
abstract: The application discloses a preparation method of a porous nanocomposite and application of the porous nanocomposite in ammonia borane hydrolysis hydrogen production; the method comprises the following steps: s1, mixing metal salt, a polydentate organic ligand and a first solvent, then performing ultrasonic dissolution, and continuously stirring after dissolution to obtain a first solution; wherein the metal salt comprises one or more of copper salt, cobalt salt and nickel salt; the first solvent is N, N-dimethylformamide; s2, heating the first solution, and keeping constant temperature and standing to obtain a second solution; s3, cooling the second solution, performing suction filtration and separation, soaking and washing to obtain a filter cake, and then performing constant-temperature drying on the filter cake to obtain MOFs powder products; s4, grinding and mixing the MOFs powder product with a co-calcinating agent to obtain mixed powder; s5, calcining the mixed powder by taking inert gas as shielding gas to obtain a porous nanocomposite; the synthetic method is simple and easy to regulate, and the synthesized composite material has the advantages of large specific surface area, high porosity, small metal nano particles and the like.

title: Aptamer for recognizing and binding CD64 protein and application thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a nucleic acid aptamer for recognizing and combining CD64 protein and application thereof. The invention provides each aptamer and mutants thereof, and the aptamer has high affinity, no immunogenicity, can be chemically synthesized in vitro, has small molecular weight, can modify and replace different parts, has stable sequence, is easy to store, is convenient to mark (no secondary antibody to be marked), and the like. When the aptamer disclosed by the invention is used for detecting CD64 protein, the operation is simple and rapid, the affinity is strong, the synthesis cost of the aptamer is lower than that of the antibody preparation cost, the period is short, and the reproducibility is good. The invention can be used in a plurality of fields such as disease diagnosis and treatment, drug screening, molecular recognition, analysis and detection and the like.

title: Compositions and methods for identifying and treating microparticle-associated diseases and conditions
abstract: The present invention relates to compositions and methods for identifying and treating signature MP-associated diseases and conditions in subjects. In particular, treatment methods of the invention include administering a gelsolin agent to produce a therapeutic effect against a signature MP-associated disease or condition in a subject.

title: Tcbuster-m transposase-specific binding proteins and uses thereof
abstract: Embodiments of the present disclosure relate to antigen-binding affinity reagents for an analyte-of-interest. In particular, the present disclosure provides novel binding proteins (antibodies), including derivatives and fragments thereof, that target TcB-M transposase, which is involved in genome editing or engineering.

title: Multispecific and multifunctional molecular and use of the same
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a multispecific or a multifunctional molecular polypeptide used in cancer treatment. SOLUTION: A multispecific or a multifunctional molecular polypeptide includes: (i) a tumor targeting portion binding to cancer antigen, which is a first tumor targeting portion for example; (ii) an immunocyte engager selected from an NK-cell engager, a T-cell engager, a B-cell engager, a dendritic cell engager or a macrophage cell engager; (iii) cytokine molecules; and (iv) two or all of interstitial adjustment portions.
