title: Compositions and methods for capture of cellular targets of bioactive agents
abstract: The present invention provides compositions and methods for capture and identification of the cellular targets of a bioactive agent. In particular, provided herein are bioactive agents tethered to capture ligand, cellular targets (optionally tagged with a reporter), capture proteins (optionally present as capture fusions), surfaces (e.g., displaying, capture ligands, capture proteins, or capture fusions), and methods of capturing and identifying the cellular targets of a bioactive agent therewith.

title: Manufacturing process remote supervision and management method and system based on cloud platform
abstract: The invention relates to a manufacturing process remote monitoring and management method and system based on a cloud platform, and belongs to the technical field of intelligent manufacturing. The method comprises the steps of obtaining manufacturing process working condition data, integrating the manufacturing process working condition data through cleaning, complementing and standardization processing to form a structural chemical working condition data set, constructing a self-evolution monitoring rule engine based on the data set, presetting an evolution target and dynamic adjustment logic, setting an intelligent working condition recognition and rule adjustment function, initializing a split scene rule storage pool, constructing a directed cross-modal causal association map through condition independence analysis, reversely tracing and positioning a defect core cause by combining the map, verifying a conduction path, carrying out differential privacy protection according to grades, and driving the engine to carry out iterative optimization by combining a defect tracing result and historical data. The method realizes the dynamic adaptation of the supervision rule to complex working conditions, accurate defect traceability, and combines data security and sharing efficiency, improves the intellectualization and robustness of the system, and adapts to the severe demand of remote supervision of high-end manufacture.

title: Photovoltaic field area progress deviation prediction and early warning method driven by unmanned aerial vehicle inspection
abstract: The invention relates to a photovoltaic field progress deviation prediction and early warning method driven by unmanned aerial vehicle inspection, and belongs to the technical field of photovoltaic field operation management. According to the method, a patrol and operation and maintenance two-dimensional progress reference model is constructed through multi-source data acquisition and standardized preprocessing, a two-branch deep learning model is utilized to predict progress deviation after core features are fused, multistage dynamic early warning and self-adaptive adjustment are achieved, and an optimization model is iterated. The method solves the problems of delayed prediction and inaccurate early warning of the traditional method, improves the configuration of the inspection operation and maintenance resources, and ensures the efficient and stable operation of the photovoltaic field.

title: Fault identification method, system, equipment and medium for distribution network uninterrupted operation
abstract: The application is suitable for the technical field of distribution networks, and provides a fault identification method for uninterrupted operation of a distribution network, which comprises the steps of acquiring monitoring data of the distribution network in real time under a plurality of view angles; the method comprises the steps of carrying out fusion on monitoring data based on a large transducer model to obtain fusion characteristic representation, carrying out fault identification on distribution network equipment based on the fusion characteristic representation to obtain potential fault data, wherein the fault data comprise potential fault points, potential fault positions and potential fault types, carrying out quantitative analysis on distribution of the distribution network equipment in a distribution network and the running state of the distribution network equipment based on the potential fault data to obtain fault risk results, dynamically adjusting a distribution network scheduling strategy based on the fault risk results to generate an operation scheduling plan, and adopting a communication technology to enable all distribution equipment in the distribution network to work cooperatively based on the operation scheduling plan. The application can improve the accuracy and efficiency of fault identification, optimize the distribution network scheduling strategy, promote the cooperative work of distribution network equipment and further improve the operation and maintenance level of the distribution network.

title: Intelligent early warning and self-adaptive regulation and control platform driven by digital twinning of water affair system
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of water conservancy project intellectualization, and discloses an intelligent early warning and self-adaptive regulation and control platform for digital twin driving of a water service system, which comprises the following steps of collecting multi-source data related to the operation of the water service system through Internet of things equipment to generate a data set with a uniform format; the method comprises the steps of integrating multi-source data through a cross-domain data fusion engine to generate a fusion feature set, analyzing causal relations among variables in the multi-source data through a time sequence causal reasoning engine to generate a dynamic causal graph, optimizing a system operation mode through information interaction among nodes to generate distributed cognitive data, generating a state graph of a water service system through a synchronous state graph visualization engine based on a topological network and the dynamic causal graph, generating a regulation command according to a multi-target cooperative regulation strategy, and updating the data set. According to the invention, through the cross-domain data fusion engine and the time sequence causality reasoning engine, abnormal events in the water service system can be accurately identified.

title: Automatic auditing and analyzing method for farmland soil data
abstract: The invention discloses an automatic auditing and analyzing method for farmland soil data, which comprises the following steps of S1, collecting soil original data to form a data set through an Internet of things sensor and unmanned aerial vehicle multispectral imaging, S2, reducing noise and removing abnormal values by adopting an extended Kalman filter, and supplementing missing data by utilizing time sequence interpolation, S3, analyzing auditing pretreatment data based on time sequence, identifying an abnormal mode, S4, analyzing and fusing auditing data by utilizing a causal reasoning graphic neural network, S5, performing multidimensional analysis and prediction on the fused data by applying a big data analysis technology, S6, realizing real-time data visualization and interactive display by adopting a quantum computing driven visualization method, S7, generating a report on the soil data set and analysis results by using a natural language generation technology, and S8, and implementing encryption and access control in the data processing and transmission process. The invention provides a comprehensive soil data processing solution, and effectively improves the data auditing efficiency, accuracy and safety.

title: Tobacco discharged high-temperature high-humidity waste gas treatment device and comprehensive treatment method
abstract: The invention discloses a tobacco discharged high-temperature high-humidity waste gas treatment device and a comprehensive treatment method, comprising a water tank, a washing tower, a gas transmission pipe and a tank body, wherein the water tank is arranged at the bottom of the outer wall of the washing tower, the top of the outer wall of the washing tower is provided with a gas pipe in a penetrating mode, the other end of the gas pipe is provided with a box body, and the top of the water tank is provided with a water pump. According to the invention, the water flow in the water tank can be cooled through the arrangement of the refrigerating sheet assembly, the water flow is conveyed into the spray pipe through the water suction pipe and the water delivery pipe through the water pump, and is sprayed out through the atomization spray nozzle, so that the high-temperature and high-humidity waste gas entering the washing tower from the air inlet pipe can be cooled, meanwhile, atomized water drops can remove particles in the waste gas and fall into the sewage pipe at the bottom of the washing tower, and the sprayed water flow can flow into the water tank again through the arrangement of the circulating water inlet pipe and the filter screen, so that the cyclic utilization of the sprayed water flow can be ensured.

title: Pressurized ammonia water discharge and recovery device
abstract: The utility model belongs to the technical field of aqueous ammonia preparation recovery plant, especially, be a pressurization aqueous ammonia discharges recovery unit, including the reaction tower, the upper and lower both ends of reaction tower are provided with the sealing layer, and the bottom of reaction tower is provided with the force (forcing) pump, and one side of force (forcing) pump is provided with first branch pipe, and one side that the force (forcing) pump was kept away from to first branch pipe is provided with first stop valve, and the bottom of first branch pipe is provided with the second stop valve, and one side of second stop valve is provided with the third stop valve, the utility model discloses a set up control module, can open and close of each part of direct control behind the feedback signal that receives first detection module, second detection module, pressure detection module, can reach comparatively automatic aqueous ammonia preparation, discharge recovery work, through setting up the operation that the slice deflector of spiral and suction pump suction water department sprayed simultaneously, reach the mesh that aqueous ammonia preparation efficiency promoted.

title: Smoke removing device of holding furnace
abstract: The utility model discloses a smoke removing device of a heat preservation furnace, which comprises a heat preservation furnace main body, baffle plates, extrusion components, reset components, a spiral air supply pipe, a unidirectional circulation mechanism, an air supply pipe, a mounting shell, an air outlet pipe, an air inlet pipe and an elastic diaphragm, wherein the mounting shell is arranged above the outer part of the heat preservation furnace main body, the air outlet pipe and the air inlet pipe are respectively arranged above and below the outer part of the mounting shell, the baffle plates are arranged on two sides of the inner part of the mounting shell, mounting frames are arranged on two sides between the baffle plates, the elastic diaphragm is arranged in the mounting frames, the extrusion components are arranged between the elastic diaphragm and the mounting shell, the reset components are arranged between the elastic diaphragm and the baffle plates, and the spiral air supply pipe is arranged on the rear side of the outer part of the heat preservation furnace main body. Compared with the prior art, the utility model has the advantages that the unidirectional property and the continuous stability of the flue gas transportation are ensured, the flue gas is cooled as much as possible before the flue gas is scrubbed, and the evaporation of liquid in the gas scrubbing bottle is reduced.

title: Closed flue gas condensate water fast discharging anti-blocking device
abstract: The utility model relates to a closed flue gas comdenstion water is arranged soon and is prevented stifled device belongs to gas boiler, energy-conservation and carries effect technique and instrument field. The utility model aims at solving the problem that boiler flue gas comdenstion water drainage is not smooth, easy to block up, causes the rust and corrosion of smoke box bottom portion promptly smoke box tube sheet around the boiler to and because the open emission of flue gas comdenstion water, cause the inside moisture in boiler room too big, corrode other equipment in boiler room. The device includes: the device comprises a tank body, a filter plate, a high-pressure spray gun, a ball screw, a pressure gauge, a temperature sensor, a water inlet, a water outlet and a sewage outlet; by adopting the design of the closed tank body and the open pipeline and by monitoring the temperature and the pressure of the flue gas condensate water in the tank body in real time, the invention can effectively solve the problems of unsmooth drainage of the flue gas condensate water of the boiler, easy blockage and rust and corrosion of the bottom tube plates of the smoke box at the front and the rear of the boiler, thereby prolonging the service life of the boiler, reducing the unnecessary energy consumption of the boiler and having positive effects on energy conservation and consumption reduction of a power plant.

title: Detergent adding structure of central air conditioner cleaning device
abstract: The utility model discloses a structure is added to central air conditioning belt cleaning device's sanitizer, its structure includes liquid reserve tank and fluid infusion mechanism, inside the liquid reserve tank through having set up fluid infusion mechanism, carry out switching-over and measurement action to leading-in liquid through quadbit two-way valve and metering valve, and carry out the high-speed joint through first quick-operation joint and outside pipeline, be favorable to improving swift and accurate effect of feeding, filter and mix the action to clean liquid through fixed net ring and arc filter screen, through having set up rabbling mechanism at the liquid reserve tank top, drive the stirring rake and scrape the mixed effect of flitch to clean liquid through agitator motor and transmission shaft, through having set up heat transfer mechanism in the liquid reserve tank bottom, the water conservancy diversion effect through heat exchanger and inlet tube carries out the heat transfer action to clean mixed liquid, and lead to heat transfer rivers through the electromagnetic directional valve.

title: Stainless steel powder treatment device and method for balance weight production
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of stainless steel powder treatment devices, in particular to a stainless steel powder treatment device and a method for producing a balance weight, the stainless steel powder treatment device comprises a tank body, wherein a stirring frame is arranged on the tank body, a top shell is fixedly arranged at the top end of the tank body, a screen is fixedly arranged on the inner side of the top shell, a driving motor is arranged on the top shell, an auger frame matched with the top shell and the screen is fixedly arranged at the output end of the driving motor, and a side shell is fixedly arranged on the top shell; according to the invention, the driving motor is controlled to operate, the screw thread blocks are driven to move through the transmission of the reciprocating screw rod, so that the screw thread blocks can drive the arc frame to move along the screen, and the arc frame drives the clamping blocks to be clamped and moved with the screen holes on the screen by using the first springs, so that the clamping blocks can clean the stainless steel powder blocked in the screen holes by using the elasticity of the first springs, and the stainless steel powder is prevented from being conveyed to be blocked.

title: Grain processing beating structure
abstract: The utility model discloses a grain processing beating structure, which comprises a base, wherein a damping mechanism is arranged on the base, the upper surface of a mounting plate is connected with a supporting rod, a lifting mechanism is arranged on the supporting rod, a cover plate is connected to the lifting mechanism, a beating mechanism is arranged on the cover plate, and an anti-accumulation mechanism is connected to the inside of a beating tank. According to the grain processing beating structure, the electric push rod is started to drive the bottom end of the connecting frame and the cover plate to move downwards, so that the fixing ring is driven to be inserted into the fixing groove, the beating tank is sealed to prevent grains from splashing out during beating, beating effect is affected, the beating motor is started to drive the gear I to rotate, the beating rod is driven to beat grains, the rotating rod can be driven to slide on the annular groove on the lower surface of the cover plate through the cooperation between the gear II and the annular rack, beating range of the beating rod can be enlarged, and grain beating is finer.

title: Rubber particle processing device
abstract: The utility model belongs to the technical field of plastic film production, in particular to a rubber particle processing device, which comprises a bottom plate, a cabinet body fixedly connected to the surface of the bottom plate, and a material pouring assembly arranged on the bottom surface of the bottom plate, wherein the material pouring assembly comprises a base arranged below the bottom plate, a first U-shaped seat symmetrically and fixedly connected to the bottom surface of the bottom plate, and a support column inserted in the first U-shaped seat, the first U-shaped seat is rotatably connected with the support column, the support column is fixedly connected with the base, a double-shaft motor is fixedly arranged on the surface of the base, and two output shafts of the double-shaft motor are respectively and fixedly connected with a turntable; the cabinet body is favorable for being lifted by a certain height, rubber particles in the cabinet body can be discharged through the discharge port under the action of self gravity, the probability of manual material scraping is reduced, the cabinet body is favorable for being supported when the cabinet body is dry, and the cabinet body is prevented from being toppled when a double-shaft motor breaks down.

title: Raw material stirring device for egg roll production
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of stirring devices, in particular to a raw material stirring device for egg roll production, which comprises a substrate and the like, wherein the substrate is an assembly carrier of the device, a stirring cylinder is arranged on the substrate, the top of the stirring cylinder is provided with a blanking opening, a top cover is semicircular and fixedly connected to the opening at the top of the stirring cylinder, the top cover is shielded at half of the opening at the top of the stirring cylinder, and the raw material stirring device further comprises a discharging frame which is arranged on one side wall of the lower part of the stirring cylinder, and a motor which is arranged on the top cover through a bracket. The top cover and the movable cover form a complete shielding cover together, raw materials can be conveniently added by rotating the movable cover, the operation is convenient, and the cleaning water can be sprayed into the stirring cylinder by arranging the plurality of spray heads on the bottom surface and the side surface of the flow guide frame, so that the cleaning efficiency is improved especially for materials which are difficult to clean on the bottom surface and the corners of the stirring cylinder.

title: Anti-spillage and anti-leakage conveying system for additive feeding process
abstract: The utility model discloses an anti-spillage conveying system in an additive feeding process, which comprises a bottom plate, wherein a box body is fixedly arranged at the top of the top plate, a feed inlet is formed in the left side of the top of the box body, a motor is fixedly arranged on the left side of the top of the box body, two groups of damping components are fixedly arranged in an inner cavity of the bottom plate, and movable wheel components are fixedly arranged at four corners of the bottom plate. According to the utility model, through the design of the box body, the feeding hole, the motor, the driving assembly, the transmission assembly and the screw cap, the additive enters the inner cavity of the box body through the feeding hole, the driving assembly is driven to rotate when the motor rotates, and the transmission assembly is driven to rotate when the driving assembly rotates, so that the additive is transmitted to the screw cap through the transmission assembly, then the additive flows out through the screw cap, and the device is more convenient to move through the design of the handle and the movable wheel assembly, so that the device can move in multiple aspects.

title: Controlled release nutraceutical carrier and its manufacturing
abstract: A manufacturing process comprising vacuum assisted extraction coupled to ultrasound treatment of food by-products to obtain a controlled release agent comprising polysaccharides and polysaccharide bonded phenols is provided. A manufacturing process for food by-products comprising 3 cycles of vacuum instantaneous expansion, 15 minutes of ultrasound assisted extraction and pH of 1.5 to obtain polysaccharides with an increased range of antioxidant activity and a decreased zeta potential is also provided. A controlled release medicine comprising the controlled release agent obtained from the manufacturing processes is provided wherein the controlled release medicine comprises an active substance or beneficial microorganisms. The active agent may be selected from analgesics, antihistamines, digestives, antibiotics, anti-inflammatory agents, polyphenolic extracts, carotenoids, cannabinoids, and vitamins. The beneficial microorganism may be selected from Lactobacillus, Saccharomyces, Bifidobacterium, Streptococcus or Akkermansia. The bonded phenols may be gallic acid or polyphenols. The polysaccharide may be cellulose and hemicellulose. The food by-product is preferable persimmon (Diospyros kaki Thunb). [Fig: None]

title: Chlamydomonas reinhardtii polysaccharide particles and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a preparation method of chlamydomonas reinhardtii polysaccharide particles, which comprises the following steps: mixing Chlamydomonas reinhardtii with water to obtain a mixed solution; adding complex enzyme into the mixed solution, adding acetic acid to adjust pH, preserving heat, and heating for extraction to obtain an extract; filtering the extracting solution and concentrating the extracting solution into clear paste with the concentration of 1.05 to 1.15 g/mL; adding absolute ethyl alcohol into the clear paste, centrifugally separating and collecting precipitate; dissolving the precipitate in water, adding cyclodextrin, mixing, and spray drying to obtain polysaccharide dry powder; mixing the polysaccharide dry powder with starch and magnesium stearate, granulating, and sieving to obtain Chlamydomonas reinhardtii polysaccharide particles; the complex enzyme comprises cellulase, pectase and superoxide dismutase. According to the preparation method, the complex enzyme is adopted for enzymolysis, so that the cell wall structure of the chlamydomonas reinhardtii can be damaged to promote the polysaccharide to be easily dissolved out, the problems of low extraction efficiency and low purity in the chlamydomonas reinhardtii polysaccharide extraction process are solved, and the loss of the polysaccharide is avoided to the greatest extent.

title: Antibacterial, anti-inflammatory and antioxidant carex meyeriana extract, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract: The invention relates to an antibacterial, anti-inflammatory and antioxidant Meyer sedge extract, a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the field of phytochemistry. Crushing the carex meyeriana, adding 50-95% ethanol with the volume and mass ratio of 8-12 times, soaking for 20-60 min, performing reflux extraction for 2 times, each time for 20-60 min, filtering, combining filtrates, concentrating, and drying to obtain the carex meyeriana. An application of Meyer sedge extract with antibacterial, antiinflammatory and antioxidant effects in preparing antibacterial, antiinflammatory or antioxidant agent is provided. The invention is an antibacterial, anti-inflammatory, antioxidant and wula sedge extract, which is derived from wula sedge of carex of cyperaceae and is an ethanol extract of the whole wula sedge, has good antibacterial, anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, and has the following effects on gram-negative bacteria, gram-positive bacteria and typical pathogenic bacteria of fungi: staphylococcus aureus, Escherichia coli, Pseudomonas aeruginosa, Candida albicans, etc.

title: Method for promoting NEMANIA SP YAFEF112,112 to produce tea stain acid
abstract: The invention provides a method for promoting NEMANIA SP YAFEF112,112 to produce tea stain acid, and relates to the technical field of microbial culture. The method comprises the steps of inoculating NEMANIA SP YAFEF112,112 mycelia into a medium containing pruned branches of the nectarines for culturing, wherein the medium is MM medium, and specific formulas are 1.52: 1.52 g/L potassium dihydrogen phosphate, 0.52: 0.52 g/L magnesium sulfate, 6: 6 g/L sodium nitrate and 0.52: 0.52 g/L potassium chloride. The invention overcomes the defects of the prior art, and provides good conditions for the production of tea stain acid by optimizing the formula of a fermentation medium and adding walnut pruning branches into the medium, improving the fermentation conditions and increasing the content of the tea stain acid in NEMANIA SP YAFEF hyphae.

title: Preparation method of wild Jin Chaishe fermented and processed oral liquid
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical fields of traditional Chinese medicine processing and microbial fermentation, and particularly relates to a preparation method of wild Jin Chaishe fermented oral liquid. The invention uses wild Jin Chaigan leaves and wild chrysanthemum as basic culture medium, obtains special strain for fermentation processing through induction training procedure, the metabolic activity of the strain is more beneficial to the full utilization and release of active ingredients in medicinal material tissues and cells during fermentation processing, and a series of bioactive ingredients can be produced, and the prepared wild golden firewood oral liquid is newly added with bioactive products and flavor substances after lactobacillus fermentation, has improved taste, and has various health care functions and natural flavor.

title: Preparation method for novel compound
abstract: The present application relates to a preparation method for a novel compound, in which there are advantages that when a compound is prepared using the preparation method of the present application, the yield is high and the reaction time is reduced.

title: Propylene ketone-containing bioinhibitor, preparation method therefor, and use thereof
abstract: The present invention relates to a propylene ketone-containing bioinhibitor, a preparation method therefor, and a use thereof. In particular, the present invention relates to the compound represented by each of the general formulas or a stereoisomer thereof, a preparation method therefor, a pharmaceutical composition containing the compound, and a use thereof in the preparation of a drug for treating cancer and other related diseases.

title: Phenyl-containing compound, intermediate thereof, preparation method therefor and application thereof
abstract: A phenyl-containing compound, an intermediate thereof, a preparation method therefor and an application thereof. Provided is a compound represented by formula I or a pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof, where R 1 , R 2 , R 3 , R 4 and R 5 are independently hydrogen, C 1 -C 6 alkyl, C 1 -C 6 alkoxy or C(=O)OR 8 ; where R 8 is C 1 -C 4 alkyl; R 6 is (II), (III) or (IV); and R 7 is -OH, -NH 2 , -NHCH 3 , -N(CH 3 ) 2 or C 1 - 4 alkoxy. The compound has a low critical micelle concentration (CMC) and good dilution resistance and is capable of enclosing an insoluble drug to form a small-molecule micelle having a high drug loading capacity and good stability.

title: Azaquinazoline ring derivative and use thereof
abstract: The present invention provides an azaquinazoline ring derivative and a use thereof. Specifically, the present invention provides a compound of formula I, or a pharmaceutically acceptable salt, tautomer, stereoisomer, stereoisomer mixture or isotopic substitute thereof. The compound has excellent cancer Osaka thyroid (Cot) kinase inhibitory activity, and thus can be used for preventing or treating (Cot) kinase-mediated diseases or disorders.

title: Benzoxazine oxazolidinone compound containing tetrahydropyridine and preparation method and application thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a benzoxazine oxazolidinone compound containing tetrahydropyridine, a preparation method thereof and application thereof in preparing medicaments for treating and/or preventing infectious diseases caused by mycobacterium tuberculosis. In particular, the invention relates to a compound shown as a formula (I) and a stereoisomer thereof, a pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof and a pharmaceutical composition containing the compound, wherein X, R 1 、R 2 As described in the specification. The present invention aims to prepare novel compounds having anti-mycobacterium tuberculosis activity, which are potential novel drugs, and at the same time, can be used to overcome the problems associated with drug resistance of mycobacterium tuberculosis, and improve the metabolic properties of drugs and enhance safety while maintaining anti-mycobacterium tuberculosis activity.

title: Method and device for dynamic switching between downlink data channel transmission or reception schemes in wireless communication system
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a 5G or 6G communication system for supporting higher data transfer rates. Specifically, the present discourse provides a method of receiving, by a terminal, transmission configuration indicator (TCI) state information in a wireless communication system, the method comprising the steps of: receiving information on a TCI state from a base station; obtaining a parameter relating to at least one of an uplink transmission beam and a downlink reception beam on the basis of the received information on the TCI state; and transmitting or receiving data to or from the base station on the basis of the determined parameter.

title: Adaptation of spatial reuse for extremely high throughput
abstract: This disclosure describes systems, methods, and devices related to spatial reuse for extremely high throughput (EHT). A device may identify a frame received from a first station device configured to operate in a first basic service set (BSS) on a first channel. The device may analyze a preamble of the frame to determine a classification of the frame. The device may adjust a calculation of a packet detection for overlapping basic service set (OBSS) value based on a number of unpunctured 20 MHz frequency channels. The device may determine to simultaneously use the first channel for communication with a second device within a second BSS based on the calculation of the packet detection for OBSS value.

title: Techniques for precoding air-to-air sidelink communications
abstract: Methods, systems, and devices for wireless communications are described. A first user equipment (UE) may receive a message indicating geographic location information related to beamforming an air-to-air sidelink message via a sidelink channel. In some examples, a second UE may transmit the message or a base station may transmit the message. The message may be the same or different as a message scheduling the sidelink message. The geographic location information may be geographic location information associated with the second UE, geographic location information associated with one or more directions to avoid when beamforming the sidelink message, or a combination thereof. The first UE may identify one or more precoding parameters based on the geographic location information. The first UE may transmit the air-to-air sidelink message to the second UE. The sidelink message may be precoded for transmission via a transmission beam using the one or more precoding parameters.

title: Terminal and control method thereof in wireless communication system
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a 5G or pre-5G communication system for supporting higher data transfer rates than that of a beyond 4G communication system such as LTE. A control method of a terminal in a wireless communication system, according to an embodiment of the present invention, may comprise the steps of: receiving radio resource control signaling (RRC signaling) for a signal measured by a terminal; identifying a transmission interval of a signal measured by the terminal, on the basis of the received RRC signaling; identifying first information for forming a predetermined beam; and determining whether to change the first information for forming a beam to second information for forming a beam, on the basis of the identified transmission interval.

title: Method and device for adjusting multi pannels based on network assistance for inter-ue communication
abstract: An operation method of a first device 100 in wireless communication system is proposed. The method may comprise: receiving, from a second device 200 , information for first spatial setting; obtaining second spatial setting related to a second beam which does not cover a first beam related to the first spatial setting; and performing, to a third device 300 , an inter-device transmission based on the second spatial setting.

title: Tap lock tooth pipe frock
abstract: The utility model provides a tap lock dental canal frock, including mounting bracket, elevating system, tightening mechanism, dental canal holder. The dental canal clamping piece comprises at least two rotating fingers and a connecting piece. The end part of the rotating finger is connected with a positioning rod through a floating structure. When the device is used, a faucet product to be assembled is fixed below the dental tube clamping piece, the lifting mechanism is started and drives the dental tube clamping piece to move downwards towards the faucet product until the positioning rod of the dental tube clamping piece pushes the positioning hole of the dental tube on the faucet product, and the rotating dental tube clamping piece drives the dental tube to rotate to screw and fix the dental tube on the faucet product to be assembled. The utility model discloses a set up floating structure, reduced the rigidity butt joint of dental canal holder with the dental canal, avoided dental canal and frock to be damaged by the bruise, improved the packaging efficiency and the equipment quality of leading product, prolonged the life of frock.

title: Connection structure of magnetic suspension rotating moving plate and rotor spindle
abstract: The utility model discloses a connecting structure of a magnetic suspension rotating moving plate and a rotor spindle, and mainly relates to the technical field of magnetic suspension molecular pumps. Including a plurality of connecting rod, rotor spindle's top is equipped with the connecting portion that contacts with integral type moving plate, and the connecting rod sets up on the connecting portion, and integral type moving plate is equipped with a plurality of through-hole, still includes the fixed cap, and connecting rod pass through after the through-hole with fixed cap sliding connection, be equipped with the stopper on the fixed cap, be equipped with on the connecting rod and erect the groove and with erect the spacing groove that the groove is linked together, erect the groove and extend to the outside, the stopper slides in proper order and sets up at perpendicular inslot and spacing inslot, be equipped with the clamp ring between fixed cap and the integral type moving plate. The utility model has the beneficial effects of solving the problem that the existing connecting structure is easy to loose or slightly displace to influence the dynamic balance of the magnetic suspension molecular pump, and improving the stability and efficiency of the connection of the magnetic suspension rotating moving plate and the rotor spindle.

title: High-strength anti-corrosion fastener for automobile engine and forming process of high-strength anti-corrosion fastener
abstract: The invention discloses a high-strength anti-corrosion fastener for an automobile engine and a forming process thereof, and belongs to the technical field of fasteners. The high-strength anti-corrosion fastener for the automobile engine comprises a screw rod and a screw cap, wherein the screw cap is fixedly connected with the surface of the top end of the screw rod, the surface of the groove is connected with a connecting sleeve, the outer wall of the connecting sleeve is fixedly connected with a connecting block, and the surface of the connecting sleeve is rotationally connected with a circular ring. This high strength anti-corrosion fastener of automobile engine through with ring and groove connection and turning adapter sleeve for the extrusion piece extrudees and promotes and presses the briquetting, makes the surface of rubber pad extrusion screwdriver, thereby carries out the centre gripping to the screwdriver, has guaranteed still can accomplish the dismantlement to the bolt under the condition of smooth silk, extrudees the inside air of pressure gas storehouse through the inside connecting rod of rubber pad, thereby promotes the connecting rod that does not contact with the screwdriver and outwards slides, thereby extrudees the surface of screwdriver, still can accomplish the dismantlement to the bolt when using other models screwdrivers.

title: Leak-proof assembly machine for drain valve sealing ring
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of drain valve processing, in particular to a drain valve sealing ring leak-proof assembly machine, which comprises: the device comprises a shell cover, a feed inlet and a discharge outlet which are formed in the shell cover, a fixing frame fixed on the side edge of the shell cover, a chassis arranged in the middle of the shell cover and a mounting plate rotationally connected above the chassis, wherein a plurality of U-shaped mounting holes are formed in the mounting plate, and a clamping assembly is arranged in the mounting holes; the clamping assembly comprises two clamping rings, a hinge part, two connecting pieces and a spring column, wherein the two clamping rings are symmetrically arranged, one ends of the clamping rings are connected in a rotating mode through the hinge part, an oval clamping space is formed between the two clamping rings, a splayed opening is formed in one end, away from the hinge part, of each clamping ring and used for guiding in a drain valve, and the two connecting pieces are fixedly connected to two sides of the hinge part respectively. The invention can effectively clamp and fix the drain valves with different diameters, thereby ensuring the installation precision of the sealing ring.

title: Adaptation fixing device and interior inspection robot system
abstract: The utility model relates to an adaptive fixing device and an internal inspection robot system, wherein the adaptive fixing device is used for being connected with a flange of a feeding port of a transformer oil tank, and comprises a connecting seat and two mounting parts, and the connecting seat is provided with a first connecting part and a second connecting part; the two mounting parts are respectively connected with the first connecting part and the second connecting part, and the end parts of the two mounting parts, which are away from each other, are used for being respectively inserted into the two mounting holes on the flange; wherein at least one of the two mounting parts is movable relative to the connection seat such that the distance between the mutually facing ends of the two mounting parts is adjustable. By adopting the structure, the adapting and fixing device can be suitable for flanges with different sizes, so that the flanges of the transformer oil tank feeding ports with different sizes can be installed by only one adapting and fixing device, the types of materials are fewer, and the cost is reduced.

title: Intelligent trolley suspension device stable in operation
abstract: The utility model discloses a suspension device for an intelligent trolley, which runs stably, relates to the technical field of suspension devices and comprises a mounting plate and a fastening assembly; mounting a plate: a fixing frame is fixed on the lower side surface, and two corresponding connecting components are installed on the left side and the right side of the mounting plate; a fastening component: the connecting frame comprises a motor, two moving plates, clamping columns and two-way screws, wherein the motor is installed on the right side surface of the fixed frame, the two corresponding moving plates are connected to the inside of the fixed frame in a sliding mode, the two corresponding clamping columns are fixed to the side surfaces of the moving plates, threaded holes are formed in the side surfaces of the moving plates, the two-way screws are connected to the inner threads of the two threaded holes in a threaded mode and are formed by welding two threaded rods with opposite threads, and the connecting frame is fixed through a fastening assembly; wherein: the input end of the motor is electrically connected with the output end of the external control switch group, so that the occurrence of fracture can be effectively avoided.

title: MODBUS transparent transmission equipment using zigbee wireless protocol
abstract: The utility model discloses an use MODBUS of zigbee wireless protocol to pass equipment thoroughly involves the information transmission field, including fuselage and first gear, the tensile fixed part that is connected is installed to the top and the both sides of fuselage, wire winding parts is installed at the top of fuselage. An object of the application is to provide an MODBUS that uses zigbee wireless agreement passes equipment thoroughly, can enlarge the installation scope of fuselage through stirring the mounting of stirring forward or backward, with adapt to not unidimensional quick-witted case, install mounting and the mount of quick-witted incasement through the mounting hole, the installation is accomplished the back, under the spring action of first spring and second spring, the fuselage can be automatic placed in the middle part to four fixed points placed in the middle of, make the fuselage can unsettled place through this fixed mode simultaneously, and then make the fuselage effectively dispel the heat through the bottom louvre, the radiating effect of fuselage has been improved, and then the life of fuselage has been prolonged.

title: A check out test set is felt to portable cigarette for distribution fortune dimension
abstract: The utility model discloses a check out test set is felt to portable cigarette for distribution fortune dimension relates to distribution fortune dimension equipment technical field, including metal diaphragm and installation panel, the installation of installation panel is fixed on the right-hand member position of metal diaphragm, the left end of metal diaphragm is provided with concave type stopper. The utility model discloses an outside cell-phone operation control of being convenient for, the positive and negative rotation of the electronic winder of electrical storage control box control, when electronic winder forward rotates, make electronic winder relieve the rolling of dragging the power cord, it is spacing because of line source assistor and concave type stopper to drag the power cord, thereby drag the power cord and be convenient for stably carry, drag the position height that the power cord is convenient for reduce the smoke detector organism like this, make personnel be convenient for maintain and overhaul, because of the line source assistor, concave type stopper, electronic winder, electrical storage control box and the spacing compactness of placing the seat are placed, make whole small, thereby portable uses.

title: Horizontal transfer case
abstract: The utility model discloses a horizontal transfer case, which comprises; the first box and second box, the one end integrated into one piece of first box has first end plate, and second box one end integrated into one piece has the second end plate, and the neat stack of second end plate is on first end plate, has all offered the screw hole on first end plate and the second end plate, and the fixed grafting of screw hole has the mounting. The fixing piece comprises a threaded bolt which is fixedly inserted into the threaded hole, and a gasket is sleeved on the threaded bolt. The first box and the second box are all offered flutedly, and first end plate and the equal integrated into one piece of second end plate one end have the locating piece, and the locating piece is all pegged graft in the recess. The fixing piece is installed in a orderly stacking mode through the first end plate and the second end plate, so that the size of the transfer case is reduced, the consumption of materials is reduced, the size and the appearance are reduced under the condition that the performance of the transfer case can be ensured, and support is provided for miniaturization of the transfer case.

title: Self-supporting lifting rod removes rack
abstract: The utility model discloses a self-supporting lifter removes rack relates to rack technical field. The utility model comprises a cabinet body; a first mounting opening is formed in the outer side surface of the cabinet body; two opposite inner side walls of the first mounting opening are respectively provided with a limiting sliding chute; the limiting sliding groove is internally and slidably connected with an electric element mounting assembly; the bottom in the cabinet body is rotatably connected with a rotating shaft; the upper end of the telescopic part is fixedly connected with a first screw rod; the peripheral side surface of the rotating shaft is fixedly connected with an outer gear ring at a position close to the bottom. The utility model discloses a be provided with spacing spout, pivot, extensible part, first lead screw, outer ring gear, second lead screw, stay tube and internal thread throw-out collar, utilize drive gear to drive the rotation of pivot and first lead screw to realize the nimble regulation of the height that the load on the electric element installation component was located, when micro motor can't the during operation, also can carry out the regulation of the height that the load was located through rotatory internal thread throw-out collar, guaranteed the flexibility of the height control that the load was located in the cabinet body.

title: Device and system
abstract: To provide a mechanism that is able to realize high performance of a mobile body further easily.SOLUTION: A device is mounted on a mobile body and used for controlling the mobile body. The device includes a holding portion and a control unit. The holding portion holds an information processor that controls the mobile body. The control unit acquires control information for controlling the mobile body from the information processor and controls the mobile body, based on the control information.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title: Work instruction method using smart devices
abstract: The present invention provides a method, which comprises the steps of: transmitting process data collected by a smart device (100) to a control unit (200); receiving, by the control unit (200), the collected process data, and analyzing the process data to generate analysis data; determining, by the control unit (200), positive data from the generated analysis data and learning the data; determining a work method in which the smart device (100) is located and a work condition of the product to be worked in the work method, by the control unit (200), and determining the positive data corresponding to the work condition and a location of the smart device (200) corresponding to the positive data to generate instruction data; and, by the control unit 200, transmitting the generated instruction data to the smart device (100).

title: Autonomous operation platform of unmanned forklift
abstract: The invention discloses an autonomous operation platform of an unmanned forklift, which comprises a traveling computer and a platform control end, wherein the traveling computer is connected with an information acquisition end, the traveling computer comprises a control module, an alarm module, a wireless output module, a positioning module, a display module, a detection module and a voice module, the platform control end comprises a wireless receiving module and an operation panel, and the platform control end is respectively connected with a cloud server and an offline server. The basic autonomous operation of unmanned fork truck is realized through the combination of the platform control end of the driving computer and the high in the clouds of taking in the fork truck under the line, through information acquisition end and orientation module, the precision navigation of fork truck has been realized, and practice thrift the cost, high durability and convenient use, through the inspection module, detect fork truck operation conditions in real time, driving computer controls fork truck, thereby guarantee unmanned fork truck's even running, the high in the clouds can real time monitoring when meetting the trouble, and in time overhaul unmanned fork truck, the practicality is stronger.

title: System and method for remotely monitoring vehicle, robot or drone
abstract: To provide a system and a method for remotely monitoring and controlling a vehicle, a robot or a drone.SOLUTION: This system has: a control module containing a computer-executable code stored in a non-volatile memory; a processor: a control center device; and a plurality of autonomous devices that operate remotely from the control center device, in which each of the plurality of autonomous devices includes a control device. The control module, processor, control center device, and control device are configured to: acquire data using one or more acquisition units located in each of the plurality of autonomous device; process the acquired data using the control devices located on the plurality of autonomous devices; transfer the processed data from the control devices to the control center device in the case that the plurality of autonomous devices are operating autonomously without control from the control center device; and train artificial intelligence according to the processed data transferred from the control device.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title: Sorting system for EtherCAT bus control balance wheels
abstract: The application belongs to the technical field of logistics equipment, and discloses a sorting system of an EtherCAT bus control balance wheel, wherein a processing device is arranged on a sorting device and is connected with the sorting device through the EtherCAT bus; the processing device comprises: the system comprises a sensor module, a detection module, an alarm module, a positioning module, a communication module and a control module; the sensor module is connected with the detection module, and the detection module receives detection signals of the sensor module; the detection module is connected with the alarm module, and the alarm module receives an alarm signal generated by the detection module according to the detection signal; the communication module is connected with the alarm module, the communication module transmits alarm information according to the alarm signal; the detection module is also connected with the positioning module, and the positioning module generates a positioning signal according to the detection signal; the control module is connected with the positioning module and controls the sorting device to sort according to the positioning signal. The instant messaging and instant response effect of the sorting system is achieved.

title: Intercom headset that can wireless online listen to music
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of headphones, in particular to an intercom headset capable of wirelessly surfing the Internet to listen to music, which comprises a headset body, wherein a microphone, a loudspeaker module, an audio module, a wireless communication module, a Bluetooth module and a control module are arranged in the headset body, the microphone and the loudspeaker module are connected with the audio module, and the audio module, the wireless communication module and the Bluetooth module are connected with the control module. The intercom headset capable of wirelessly surfing the Internet to listen to music can realize traditional Bluetooth music playing, can also realize wireless surfing functions of the headset, comprises functions of network music playing, AI real-time consultation interaction and the like, and realizes remote interaction intercom application under the cooperation of a control module through PTT keys and shortcut keys.

title: Method and apparatus of cross-component adaptive loop filtering for video coding.
abstract: Methods and apparatus for video coding are disclosed. According to one method, First ALF (Adaptive Loop Filter) processing is applied to the reconstructed chroma samples for a target reconstructed chroma sample to generate a first filtered chroma sample. Second ALF processing is applied to the related reconstructed luma samples to generate a second filtered chroma sample for the target reconstructed chroma sample, where positions of the related reconstructed luma samples selected for the second ALF processing are determined according to the target chroma format. According to another method, the luma ALF and the cross-component ALF have the same filter coefficient precision.

title: Secondary feature extraction and malicious attack identification method based on kernel principal component analysis
abstract: The invention provides a secondary feature extraction and malicious attack identification method based on kernel principal component analysis. The method comprises the following steps: step 1, hierarchically sampling the acquired malicious traffic to acquire a more balanced training sample set and a more balanced testing sample set; step 2, preprocessing an original network traffic data set to obtain a more standard data set; step 3, extracting the characteristics of the preprocessed network flow by using a secondary characteristic extraction method based on kernel principal component analysis, and effectively eliminating redundant information in original network flow data; step 4, the extracted features are used for training a classification model, and classification and identification are carried out on different malicious attack behaviors; and 5, obtaining a network flow malicious attack detection report according to the identification result obtained in the step 4. The invention simultaneously considers the characteristics of the data in two aspects of mean value and variance, and further more comprehensively analyzes the data characteristics.

title: Improved Ziegler-Natta catalyst and preparation method and application thereof
abstract: The invention discloses an improved Ziegler-Natta catalyst and a preparation method and application thereof. The improved Ziegler-Natta catalyst comprises a carrier, a main catalyst, a cocatalyst and an internal electron donor; the carrier is anhydrous magnesium chloride; the main catalyst is titanium trichloride and/or titanium tetrachloride; the cocatalyst is triethyl aluminum; the internal electron donor is an antistatic agent. The improved Ziegler-Natta catalyst is used for synthesizing the ultra-high molecular weight polyethylene due to the addition of the antistatic agent, can effectively prevent scaling caused by electrostatic effect, enables the reaction to be continuously carried out, and enables the antistatic agent in the catalyst to be uniformly dispersed in a reaction system, so that the prepared ultra-high molecular weight polyethylene has uniform particles and high bulk density, and the improved Ziegler-Natta catalyst has higher catalytic activity.

title: Method of generating a multiplexed image for printing
abstract: A method of generating a multiplexed image (18) for printing that can be observed in a plurality of modes includes determining a finite shape (22) of a multiplexed palette (10) in a combined color space. The contrast of the multiplexed image (18) in each mode can be optimized by determining a maximum volume hyperrectangle (20) enclosed in the finite shape (22). Gamut mapping to this maximum volume hyperrectangle (20) allows for generation of a multiplexed image (18) that has a maximum contrast and is free from artifacts caused by an interdependency between the colors in each mode. Performing a dimensionality reduction using PCA allows for reducing the complexity of the optimization problem.
